items.text: Chargers (off a bye): WR Ladd McConkey (concussion, still in protocol), RT Joe Alt (neck), CB Donte Jackson and CB Rodney Shelley (hamstrings) were back on the field Monday; S Derwin James and WR Tre' Harris (hamstrings) were on the side field. LT Rashawn Slater is on IR.
Rams WR Davante Adams (ruptured hamstring) is on IR, out 6-10 weeks. DT Poona Ford is out for the season and DT Kobie Turner at least three more games; CB Trent McDuffie (groin) could return soon.
Rams EDGE Myles Garrett (knee, IR) is likely to practice and could play against the Chargers, per Rapoport; Sean McVay is 'not sure yet.'
